'''''Visions and Verities: A Collection of Essays on Myth, Symbolism, and Ritual within Voss Society''''' was a collection of essays regarding the cultural practices of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] written by Dr. [[Eksa Fa'kar]]. It included, amongst other things, a description of the [[Interpreter's Retreat]] on [[Voss-Ka]] and a description of the role of the interpreter within Voss society.<ref name="Codex" />
